title: ci(test-shards): the weekly shard-timings refresh is refused by the partitioner's own self-test — @objectstack/cli (1432 s) can be neither kept whole nor sliced under the density bound
body:
domain:devx#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2gLghEqeDKTbDTC7Zd

Filing gate: ① a measured red on a generated PR the `domain:devx` lane owns (the weekly refresh, #22949 ruling E). Found while answering triage's stale-PR sweep on PR #28978.
Reader: `domain:devx` (`scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs`, its `slice spread` check in the self-test).
Dedupe (open AND closed): `slice spread`, `partition-test-shards cli whole slice`, `shard-timings`. #25870 (open) is about the two slowest shards' wall clock, not this refusal. #25936 is about the refresh PR's token. No card for this refusal.
reach: every weekly refresh until the partitioner or the dataset changes. The next scheduled run is Monday 05:30Z (`shard-timings-refresh.yml`, `cron: '30 5 * * 1'`).
type: Bug

## What happens
The 2026-11-02 refresh (run 41394864471) opened PR #28978 (head `b5b4b790`, one file, +261/−405). On that head, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates` is red on one gate, `Shard partitioner self-test` (`node scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs --self-test`):

```
Error: slice spread: the committed dataset, split as CI splits it, carries no slice -- @objectstack/cli: whole (whole 1432s against 736s, 1.3x the heaviest other serial task, but sliced the densest shard would carry 1552.63s, past the 1455.81s densit…
    at partition-test-shards.mjs:2125
```

The refreshed timings put `@objectstack/cli` at 1432 s. The check wants the dataset to carry at least one slice. Slicing `cli` would push the densest shard past the density bound, and keeping it whole leaves no slice, so the check refuses either way. `Lint & Repo Gates` is red only because it aggregates that lane.

## Wanted
- Decide which side is wrong. Either the check's "carries a slice" expectation no longer fits the measured workload, or the density bound or shard count needs to move for a 1432 s serial task. Measure it on the refreshed dataset rather than the committed one.
- ⛔ Do not delete or weaken the check to make the refresh land. Do not hand-edit the generated timings.
- When this lands, re-run the refresh or let Monday's run regenerate it. PR #28978 is parked on this card.
